name: ai-social-media-operator
description: Browser extension agent for automated content generation and social media interaction on Threads, Facebook, and X

scripts.build: npx --yes esbuild src/content/content_main.js --bundle --outfile=public/content_main.bundle.js --format=iife && npx --yes esbuild src/background/background.js --bundle --outfile=public/background.bundle.js --format=esm
scripts.package: npm run build && zip -r ai-social-media-operator-v1.1.1.zip manifest.json public/ src/ -x '*.DS_Store'

author: Antigravity AI
